title: Joint Rescue Coordination Center
description: Package story about the JRCC at Honolulu's District 14 in Hawaii.  The mission is to coordinate search and rescue for distress calls throughout the central Pacific.  Information is also given about ways boaters can make themselves easier to find if lost.
keywords: District 14, JRCC, boating safety, Coast Guard, Hawaii, search and rescue, Pacific
